definitions.explanation: Having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities; overbearingly proud and looking down on others.

examples.japanese: {傲慢|ごうまん}な{態度|たいど}。
{彼|かれ}は{成功|せいこう}して{傲慢|ごうまん}になった。
examples.english: He became arrogant after his success.

examples.japanese: {傲慢|ごうまん}さは{人|ひと}を{遠|とお}ざける。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{傲慢|ごうまん}な{態度|たいど} - arrogant attitude
・{傲慢|ごうまん}な{人|ひと} - arrogant person
・{傲慢|ごうまん}さ - arrogance (noun form)
・{傲慢|ごうまん}になる - to become arrogant

ADJECTIVE FORMS:
・{傲慢|ごうまん}な + noun: {傲慢|ごうまん}な{態度|たいど}
・{傲慢|ごうまん}に + verb: {傲慢|ごうまん}に{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う (to behave arrogantly)

CONTRAST:
・{傲慢|ごうまん} - arrogant (looking down on others)
・{卑屈|ひくつ} - servile, subservient (opposite extreme)
・{謙虚|けんきょ} - humble (positive quality)
